subject: EdgeBank: notification of anomalous token use & evidence onboarding request
messages:
From: EdgeBank Security <security@edgebank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: [EdgeBank] Anomalous token use detected — request for IRP + SOC2 evidence

Hi Rafael / Karthik,

We observed a burst of anomalous token activity from a handful of EdgeBank test accounts that hit Redwood's hosted endpoint between 03:30–03:45 UTC this morning. There is no confirmed data exfiltration at this time but our security and risk teams want to treat this as a potential incident.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether this activity originated from a Redwood process or a customer-facing process?
- We need a copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) for onboarding and a mapped list of SOC 2 evidence artifacts you can provide (audit logs, access logs, change-history).
- Please accept a telemetry snapshot we collected (attached) and confirm a secure upload path or temporary S3 credentials so we can share larger artifacts.

Attached: edgebank-telemetry-snapshot-08-14.json (sanitized sample).

EdgeBank point of contact: Laura Chen, Senior Incident Responder (laura.chen@edgebank.com)

Thanks — we appreciate quick confirmation of next steps and an ETA for the artifacts.

— EdgeBank Security
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: EdgeBank Security <security@edgebank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [EdgeBank] Anomalous token use detected — request for IRP + SOC2 evidence

Hi Laura / EdgeBank team,

Thank you for the heads up and for the telemetry snapshot — we received the attachment and are pulling initial logs now. I’ve looped in Karthik (Security & Ops) and Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate.

Short plan from our side:
1) Karthik will triage server-side logs, ingress tokens, and any recent deploys that might explain bursts.
2) We will provide a redacted IRP summary and a SOC2 evidence index you can use for review.
3) If you prefer, we can create a short-term secure folder (Google Drive with constrained access) for larger artifacts; otherwise we can accept S3 temporary credentials.

Please advise which upload method you prefer. If you have an internal case number, share it and we’ll attach it to our internal ticket for tracking. Our current ETA to deliver the IRP summary + evidence index is 24–48 hours unless triage uncovers blocking items.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partner Success — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: EdgeBank Security <security@edgebank.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [EdgeBank] Anomalous token use detected — request for IRP + SOC2 evidence

Thanks Laura / team — quick update from triage:
- We replayed the token activity against our request logs and found the calls were authenticated with a long-lived key associated with a customer sandbox integration. No signs of backend compromise so far (no privilege escalation, no unusual outbound connections).
- We are collecting the following artifacts for you: API access logs (UTC timestamps), auth token creation/change history, deployment audit for the past 72 hours, and tenant-scoped request payload samples with PII redacted.

Per Rafael’s note, attaching an evidence index and a proposed IRP action-item outline for coordination. Documents attached: soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, irp-action-items.docx.

Quoted for context:
> We observed a burst of anomalous token activity from a handful of EdgeBank test accounts that hit Redwood's hosted endpoint between 03:30–03:45 UTC this morning.

What we can provide immediately (within 24 hours):
- SOC 2 related artifacts: access logs, change control entries, user provisioning snapshots, and sampling of relevant alerts.
- SIG/CAIQ crosswalk for the controls that map to the activity you observed.

Questions for EdgeBank: please confirm whether you need fully redacted artifacts or a hashed identifier mapping (we can provide either). Also confirm your preferred upload link — we will mirror any artifacts to the Drive folder Rafael suggested: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EdgeBank-Onboarding.

Karthik Iyer
Security & Reliability
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (index of candidate evidence), irp-action-items.docx (proposed coordination checklist)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgebank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [EdgeBank] Anomalous token use detected — request for IRP + SOC2 evidence

Thanks Rafael / Karthik — appreciate the quick triage and the artifacts list. We will: 
- Upload the full telemetry dump to the Drive folder you provided and grant access to karthik_iyer@redwood.com and rafael_mendes@redwood.com by EOD today.
- Include an internal case ID (EBK-20250814-IR) in the upload and attach the raw snapshot (edgebank-telemetry-snapshot-08-14.json).

Can you confirm an estimated window for the initial IRP summary and a timeline for a post-incident write-up? Our compliance team is requesting an SLA-aligned acknowledgement and a postmortem within 7 business days if the incident is validated.

We’ll proceed with the Drive upload and notify you once permissions are set.

Best regards,
Laura Chen
Senior Incident Responder, EdgeBank
laura.chen@edgebank.com | +1 (617) 222-3344

Attachment: edgebank-telemetry-snapshot-08-14.json (full dump will follow via Drive link)
